steps.title: Run Script
steps.description:
Press Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) or **AXIS: Run Script**. The AXIS Run channel should log `engine=pyodide … uploaded=0`.
[Run Script](command:axis.runScript)

axis.telemetry.offline.description: Keep product telemetry off by default in IDE.

axis.engine.endpoint.markdownDescription: PYNE Pro / engine base URL (no `/run` suffix). Defaults to loopback. Remote URLs require `#axis.engine.allowRemoteEndpoint#`.

axis.engine.allowRemoteEndpoint.markdownDescription: When false (default), `axis.engine.endpoint` must be loopback (`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `::1`) so the Pro Bearer key is not sent off-machine. **Application (user) scope only** — workspace settings cannot enable remote endpoints. Opt in only for trusted remote Pro hosts.

axis.engine.allowPyodide.markdownDescription: Local Pyodide 0.29.5 bars-in calculator (Wave 1 default **on**). Host loads Wasm from jsDelivr into `globalStorage` (not the VSIX). `ready` after a 1+1 smoke plus pynescript Runtime smoke (trusted hoox-pyne wheel). Source is **not** uploaded (`uploaded=0`). Numba/R2/cron are not available in Wasm. Set false to force remote `/run` only.

axis.engine.pyodideWheelUrl.markdownDescription: Optional `https://` or `file://` URL (or filesystem path) of a trusted `hoox-pyne` / pynescript `py3-none-any` wheel for Pyodide micropip. Empty uses `media/pyodide/` then sibling `pynescript/dist`. Wasm is never this setting.

axis.chart.historyBars.markdownDescription: Default OHLCV history window for new chart sessions and when the document omits a positive `historyBars`. Counts are clamped to **20000** (same as this maximum).

axis.chart.useMockBars.markdownDescription: When true, chart sessions and runs use deterministic mock/fixture bars (opt-in). Default **false** fetches real OHLCV from `axis.datafeed.url` (local axis-datafeed sidecar, default `http://127.0.0.1:5003`).

axis.datafeed.url.markdownDescription: Base URL for the local `@hoox-sh/axis-datafeed` sidecar (`GET /datafeed/ohlcv`). Defaults to loopback `:5003`. Remote URLs require `#axis.engine.allowRemoteEndpoint#`.
